summary: Harden #629/#640: decide_er_plan (approve|revise|reject via shared pending ledger), er_planning_feed_items (pending epic/release + incomplete sessions), feed/CLI/MCP parity with feature planning decide surfaces.

3. Decide: plate_er_planning_decide plan_id approve|revise|reject (or gh plate er-plan --decide ID).

agent_notes: Never cut/tag on release plan approve. Incomplete ER sessions live under .agentic/planning/er_sessions/. Pending plans shared with feature planning under .agentic/planning/pending/.
